integrity: The exact source formula was independently normalized and the defect identity was symbolically replayed from the included checker. Numerical examples are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes only the orthogonal-simplex family of Remark 4.5; it does not determine the globally best body for each fixed pair of dimension and Minkowski asymmetry.
title: Exact defect profile for the orthogonal-simplex Banach--Mazur sharpness family
